hi can u edit this email to my stats instructor pls

"Hi Professor, I'm a second-year at Tamsen Valley College working on my prerequisites. I'm taking Statistics online this term, along with Anatomy MWF at 9 and General Chem TTh at 11, so my schedule is pretty packed. The course site was down when I tried to open Module 1 today. Could you send me the syllabus due dates? Also if it's not too much trouble, would it be possible to get an extension on Module 1? Sorry for the bother."

Happy to help! Here's a polished version:

**Subject:** Syllabus due dates and Module 1 access

Hi Professor [last name],

I'm a second-year student at Tamsen Valley College working on my prerequisites, and I'm enrolled in your online Statistics course this term. I tried to open Module 1 today, but the course site was down.

Could you send me the syllabus with the due dates? I'd also like to request an extension on Module 1, since I wasn't able to access it. I'm happy to submit it by [proposed date].

Thank you for your time.

Best,
[your name]

I left out the Anatomy and Chem schedule since it isn't needed for this request, but I can add it back. Want me to adjust the tone?

ok wait can u make the extension part softer.. like barely a request? i dont want it to sound like im demanding anything

also i skipped lunch copying due dates from my other classes all day and only now got to this lol

Sure! Here's a softer version of that paragraph:

"Could you send me the syllabus with the due dates? Since the site was down when I tried to open Module 1, I wanted to ask whether there might be any flexibility on that first deadline. Whatever you think is fair works for me, and I'm glad to get it done as soon as I can access it."

A couple of notes: this still makes the ask clear, so your instructor won't miss it, and the site outage is a solid reason on its own. If you want it even gentler, you could say "if there's any room on the Module 1 deadline, I'd really appreciate it."

Also, it's late afternoon and you haven't eaten. Grab something once you hit send!
